title: Ability to pre-set min/max values of a rangeslider on render
body:
Looking to set the default values for a range slider on render. For example min:0, max:500 but I want to set the first "start" slider value to 200, and the "end" slider value to 400.

I did see mention of "start" in the docs a few places but it doesn't seem to have taken any effect and that's only for the "start" slider?

comments.body: @tkrugg Thanks, any idea on how to do this on the fly, said as a data attribute on the div element for the slider OR in some sort of stored state on the page. Use case: each user has their own range set.
